content_text:
Participant
I really enjoy every conversation on your podcast, thank you for all the insights you and your guests share.
I’d love to suggest filmmaker Sergei Dvortsevoy as a possible guest.
His film Tulpan got Un Certain Regard at Cannes, and Ayka was shortlisted for the Oscars. He’s currently working on a new film. Would love to hear your converasation with him! and if needed I’d be glad to help make an introduction!
